meta.label: Modern Emerald nuzlocke viability
meta.blurb: Curated for Trash Pack–style Modern Emerald runs (level caps, permadeath). Letters are opinionated starting points — the reason is the point. Not Smogon, not raw BST. Species without an entry sit in Untiered until curated.

9.reason: Bulky Water/Ice toolkit with reliable STAB — late arrival hurts, but it walls common late-game special attackers.

25.reason: Early Electric coverage, but frail and outclassed once Magneton / Manectric lines come online.

26.reason: Fast Electric revenge killer with Thunderbolt access — glass, but answers Water walls cleanly.

59.reason: Huge Attack + Intimidate pivot; Fire coverage punches holes in Grass/Steel and Steel/Fairy checks.

65.reason: Psychic nuke with Calm Mind + Recover options; struggles into Dark/Bug but carries special midgames.

68.reason: Raw Fighting power for Norman and late Dark types, but slow and hated by Flying/Psychic.

76.reason: Rock/Ground wall with Explosion panic button — useful locally, outsped and walled too often.

80.reason: Bulky Water/Psychic pivot with Calm Mind; Thunder Wave + Surf keeps midgame fights honest.

94.reason: Ghost/Poison that ignores Normal and threatens special walls; Levitate formes (ME) dodge Ground.

130.reason: Intimidate + Dragon Dance + Water/Flying STAB breaks level-cap gyms once it gets a boost turn.

131.reason: Special Water wall with Ice Beam; slow setup, but softens special checks for the late game.

134.reason: Wish + Water STAB cleric that also hits hard specially — glue for unstable midgames.

135.reason: Speed + Thunderbolt revenge; frail, but answers Water cores before they snowball.

136.reason: Physical Fire with Flare Blitz–style pressure (ME movepools vary) — trades bulk for OHKO threat.

143.reason: Huge HP Normal tank; RestTalk sets stall fights, but Fighting weakness is everywhere.

149.reason: Dragon/Flying with Outrage + Extreme Speed options in ME — late, but League-defining once evolved.

169.reason: Poison/Flying with Mean Look + Toxic stall; Confuse Ray buys turns under tight caps.

181.reason: Electric wallbreaker with Thunder + Heal Bell support; Mega/ME bulk makes it a midgame anchor.

196.reason: Fast Psychic Calm Mind sweeper; answers Fighting/Poison and races special walls.

197.reason: Dark tank with Wish + Toxic; absorbs Psychic and pivots status safely.

208.reason: Steel/Ground physical wall; answers Fairy/Rock locally but hates Water/Fighting and is slow.

212.reason: Bug/Steel with Technician-adjacent chip and Swords Dance pressure — answers Psychic/Dark gyms.

214.reason: Bug/Fighting megaton Attack; Guts/ME boosts let it smash Norman and late Normal cores.

227.reason: Steel/Flying physically bulky pivot; Spikes/Roost sets (when available) help, but Electric/Fire hurts.

229.reason: Dark/Fire with Nasty Plot or Crunch pressure; deletes Grass/Ghost and softens special walls.

230.reason: Swift Swim Water under rain (or just raw special bulk) — Ice Beam + Surf covers late Dragons.

242.reason: Softboiled Normal cleric with Seismic Toss consistency; Fighting weakness is the tax.

248.reason: Rock/Dark with huge Attack and Intimidate options — walls special and breaks physical cores.

254.reason: Grass/Dragon (ME) or Grass sweeper with Leaf Blade + Dragon Dance paths — answers Water gyms hard.

257.reason: Blaze Blaziken-style Speed + Fighting coverage; deletes Norman and threatens late Ice/Steel.

260.reason: Water/Ground starter with Ice coverage — answers Wattson-to-Wallace threat stack almost alone.

272.reason: Water/Grass with Leech Seed + Rain Dish longevity; slow, but softens Juan/Wallace prep.

275.reason: Grass/Dark with Explosion panic — early utility, falls off when real Grass answers arrive.

277.reason: Normal/Flying Speed demon; Guts Facade or STAB Aerial Ace melts under level caps.

279.reason: Water/Flying with Water Sport/Protect utility; fine early surf taxi, outclassed as a fighter.

282.reason: Psychic/Fairy (ME) or Psychic Calm Mind + Trace; walls Fighting and special-sweeps midgame.

286.reason: Grass/Fighting with Spore + Focus Punch / Mach Punch — deletes Normal gyms and walls.

289.reason: Truant monster Attack; Yawn + Return patterns win if you play the loaf turns correctly.

292.reason: Wonder Guard cheese — only Super Effective hits land; breaks entire gyms when typed right.

297.reason: Pure Fighting with Thick Fat; answers Norman, hates Flying/Psychic and needs support.

301.reason: Normal cute Charm pivot; status helper early, zero late-game damage.

302.reason: Dark/Ghost with stall tools; answers Psychic, but frail and Fire-weak.

306.reason: Steel/Rock megaton defenses; answers Fairy/Ice/Flying threats and anchors League physical.

308.reason: Fighting/Psychic with dual STAB; flexible, but Speed and frailty keep it out of S.

310.reason: Electric with Intimidate + Thunderbolt; pivots Water and answers Juan safely.

319.reason: Water/Dark with Crunch + Surf; Speed helps, but Electric/Fighting and frailty bite.

323.reason: Fire/Ground with Eruption ceiling; early route filler that folds to Water.

324.reason: Fire wall with Drought/ME heat; answers Grass/Ice, hates Water/Ground.

330.reason: Ground/Dragon with Outrage + Earthquake; late evolution, League-threatening once online.

334.reason: Dragon/Flying with Cotton Guard / Dragon Dance paths; supportive, not a primary breaker.

344.reason: Ground/Psychic with dual screens / Cosmic Power; answers Electric, hates Water/Ice/Dark.

350.reason: Water with Marvel Scale + Recover; Calm Mind sweeps when statused correctly.

354.reason: Ghost with huge Attack; Shadow Ball / Shadow Claw deletes Psychic and Normal-immune checks.

359.reason: Dark with Super Luck crits / Sucker Punch revenge; answers Psychic and Ghost cleanly.

365.reason: Ice/Water with Thick Fat; answers Dragon/Flying locally, slow and Fighting-weak.

373.reason: Dragon/Flying physical nuke; Intimidate + DD makes it a League closer under caps.

376.reason: Steel/Psychic with Bullet Punch priority and Meteor Mash — answers Fairy/Ice and late specials.

461.reason: Dark/Ice (ME Weavile) Speed + Knock Off / Ice Shard — revenge kills Dragons and Psychics.

462.reason: Electric/Steel Magneton evolution — Volt Switch + Flash Cannon deletes Water/Fairy walls.

464.reason: Ground/Rock (ME Rhyperior) megaton Attack; Solid Rock softens SE hits under caps.

466.reason: Electric (ME Electivire) with Motor Drive / Wild Charge; answers Water, hates Ground.

467.reason: Fire (ME Magmortar) special wallbreaker; answers Grass/Steel, needs Speed support.

468.reason: Fairy/Flying (ME Togekiss) with Air Slash flinches + Nasty Plot — softens physical cores.

472.reason: Ground/Flying (ME Gliscor) with Poison Heal stall; answers Electric, hates Ice/Water.

473.reason: Ice/Ground (ME Mamoswine) with Ice Shard + EQ; deletes Dragons before they move.

475.reason: Psychic/Fighting (ME Gallade) with Close Combat + Leaf Blade; answers Dark/Normal gyms.

477.reason: Ghost (ME Dusknoir) with Pain Split / Will-O-Wisp; physical sponge for League.

10.reason: Unevolved Bug fodder — replace at first real encounter.

13.reason: Unevolved Bug fodder — no damage, no bulk, no future.

16.reason: Early Normal/Flying filler; evolves into a middling Pidgeot that still loses key MUs.

19.reason: Early Normal rodent — fine for route 1, liability past the first gym.

129.reason: Magikarp does nothing until Gyarados; dead weight under strict death rules if forced early.

161.reason: Sentret line is early Normal filler with no late-game path.

191.reason: Sunkern has the worst BST in the game — only Sunny Day cheese keeps it from F.

261.reason: Poochyena is early Dark filler; Mightyena is usable, the baby form is not.

263.reason: Zigzagoon is pickup utility; Linoone carries, the base form does not.

265.reason: Wurmple is pure evolution fodder — no fights until Beautifly/Dustox.

270.reason: Lotad early is weak; wait for Lombre/Ludicolo before investing deaths.

273.reason: Seedot early is weak; Nuzleaf/Shiftry are the actual Pokémon.

280.reason: Ralts is fragile evolution bait — the tier value is entirely in Kirlia→Gardevoir/Gallade.

283.reason: Surskit is early Bug/Water filler; Masquerain is situational at best.

293.reason: Whismur line only matters at Exploud; base form is noise without damage.

316.reason: Gulpin is early Poison stall bait; Swalot can Toxic stall, Gulpin cannot.

322.reason: Numel is slow Fire/Ground fodder until Camerupt, and even then Water ends it.

327.reason: Spinda’s confusion gimmick rarely wins real fights under level caps.

352.reason: Kecleon’s Color Change is cute; middling stats mean it rarely finishes gyms.

358.reason: Chimecho is a frail Psychic with Heal Bell — support niche, not a carry.

424.reason: Normal with Technician Fake Out / Double Hit — early Speed control, falls off late.

430.reason: Dark/Flying with Super Luck crits; answers Psychic and Grass, hates Electric/Ice/Rock.

465.reason: Grass wall with Regenerator-adjacent longevity in ME; answers Water/Ground, hates Ice/Fire/Bug.

469.reason: Bug/Flying Speed + Speed Boost paths; threatens special walls once online.

470.reason: Grass Eeveelution with Leaf Blade; answers Water/Ground, outclassed by Breloom/Sceptile.

471.reason: Ice Eeveelution with Freeze-Dry (when available) — answers Dragons and Ground.

474.reason: Normal special nuke with Adaptability-style STAB; deletes walls that lack Fighting.

478.reason: Ice/Ghost with Snow Cloak / spikes utility; answers Dragons and Psychic, hates Rock/Steel/Fire.

700.reason: Fairy with Pixilate Hyper Voice (ME) — walls Dragons and deletes Dark/Fighting cores.

900.reason: Bug/Rock with Sharpness / Stone Axe pressure — answers Flying/Ice, hates Water/Steel.

901.reason: Ground/Normal Ursaluna with Belly Drum / EQ — slow nuke that ends physical walls.

979.reason: Fighting/Ghost Annihilape with Rage Fist snowball — ignores Normal and threatens bulk cores.

981.reason: Normal/Psychic Farigiraf with Armor Tail; niche anti-priority, middling offense.

82.reason: Electric/Steel Magneton — Flash Cannon + Thunderbolt deletes Water/Fairy before Magnezone.

81.reason: Magnemite is evolution bait; the tier value is Magneton/Magnezone.

264.reason: Linoone with Belly Drum + Extreme Speed (ME) — glass but breaks midgame once set up.

262.reason: Mightyena with Intimidate + Crunch; early Dark answer that fades late.

267.reason: Beautifly is a frail Bug/Flying — Quiver Dance cheese only.

269.reason: Dustox is a special Bug/Poison sponge; Toxic stall niche, low damage.

295.reason: Exploud with Boomburst (ME) — special Normal wallbreaker, Fighting-weak.

317.reason: Swalot Toxic + Stockpile stall; slow and replaced by better Poisons.

332.reason: Cactus with Sand Veil / Swords Dance; answers Water locally, hates Ice/Flying/Fire.

342.reason: Water/Dark with Adaptability-style STAB in ME; answers Psychic, Electric-weak.

346.reason: Rock/Grass with Storm Drain; answers Water/Electric, hates Ice/Fighting/Bug.

348.reason: Rock/Bug with Swords Dance; answers Flying/Ice, hates Water/Steel/Rock.

356.reason: Dusclops is the bulky Ghost pivot before Dusknoir — Pain Split sets midgame.

362.reason: Ice with Sheer Cold cheese / solid defenses; answers Dragons, hates Fighting/Steel/Fire.

372.reason: Shelgon is mid-evolution fodder — Salamence is the actual Pokémon.

375.reason: Metang is mid-evolution Steel — Metagross holds the tier.

3.reason: Venusaur with Sleep Powder + Giga Drain; answers Water/Ground, hates Ice/Fire/Flying.

6.reason: Charizard with Drought/ME Fire/Flying pressure — answers Grass/Bug, hates Rock/Water/Electric.

31.reason: Nidoqueen with Earth Power + toxic spikes utility; answers Electric, hates Ground/Psychic/Water.

34.reason: Nidoking with Sheer Force special sets; answers Electric, same 4x Ground fear.

45.reason: Vileplume with Sleep Powder + Strong STAB; answers Water, hates Fire/Ice/Flying.

62.reason: Poliwrath with Water/Fighting STAB; answers Norman/Rock, hates Electric/Flying/Psychic.

91.reason: Cloyster with Shell Smash + Icicle Spear; glass but breaks once it boosts.

121.reason: Starmie with Rapid Spin + dual STAB; answers Fighting/Fire, frail into Dark/Ghost/Bug.

141.reason: Kabutops with Swords Dance Water/Rock; answers Flying/Ice/Fire, hates Grass/Electric/Fighting.

164.reason: Noctowl is a special Flying sponge; Reflect support niche only.

178.reason: Xatu with Magic Bounce / dual screen support; answers Fighting, frail offensively.

186.reason: Politoed with Drizzle (ME) enables rain offense; mediocre alone.

195.reason: Quagsire is a Water/Ground Unaware sponge; answers Electric, hates Grass.

205.reason: Forretress with Rapid Spin + spikes; passive, needs a partner to win.

211.reason: Qwilfish with Intimidate + spikes; early Water/Poison utility.

226.reason: Mantine is a special Water/Flying wall; zero offense under caps.

237.reason: Hitmontop with Intimidate + priority; role compression, middling damage.

291.reason: Ninjask with Speed Boost + Baton Pass / SD; supports better mons more than it finishes.

303.reason: Mawile with Huge Power physical sets; answers Dark/Ice, hates Fire/Ground.
